task.title: Close awkit-g555 on the measured kill-and-restart fix and record the 0.8B re-measurement on L1
task.objective: The owner chose kill-and-restart for awkit-g555. It is built at 6ca6297a and proven by verify:ai-adapter 117/117 and verify:ai-host-electron 26/0, both mutation-tested, and measured on Qwen3.5-0.8B at d8162f86: cancel latency 1020 ms under the 3000 ms ceiling, settled by the kill during prompt evaluation, and 62 ms settled by the host itself during generation. Append a note and close awkit-g555 with that evidence. Append a note to awkit-djnl.1 that the 0.8B now passes 7 of 8 criteria and is still NO-GO on validationExplanation at cap, 132300 ms against 120000. Refresh the JSONL export. awkit-djnl.1 stays in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/ai-harness/locatorUpgradePacket.ts and scripts/offline-benchmark/ are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-g555 is closed with a note and reason naming the fix commit, the verifiers and the measured 1020 ms, awkit-djnl.1 stays in_progress with a note giving the 0.8B re-measurement, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree once its tracker pin names the new totals.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree', against the final state after `bd update awkit-g555 --append-notes`, `bd close awkit-g555`, `bd update awkit-djnl.1 --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the state-document updates. Round 1 was 176/177 on the hardcoded tracker pin, which measured 9 outstanding / 294 closed with edges unchanged at 135. The pin was moved to those measured values with its history comment, and round 2 passed. Both narratives restate the measured 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED.

history.released_reason: awkit-g555 closed on the measured fix, 0.8B re-measurement noted on awkit-djnl.1, no edge changed, export refreshed
